description:
A homeowner in Phoenix, Arizona is considering installing rooftop solar panels and wants to know how much electricity a typical residential system would produce annually.

Design and simulate a 5 kW DC photovoltaic system for their south-facing roof, which has a slope of approximately 20 degrees. Use NREL's System Advisor Model tools available on this machine to run the simulation with real Phoenix weather data.

Save the complete simulation results as a JSON file at:
/home/ga/Documents/SAM_Projects/Phoenix_Residential_5kW.json

The output should include the system configuration parameters you used, location information, and the simulation results including annual energy production in kWh.
